name: MedInstruct-52k
description: A diverse, machine-generated medical instruction-finetuning dataset created using GPT-4 and ChatGPT with expert-curated seeds, designed to improve medical instruction-following ability and generalizability of large language models.
reputation: A commonly referenced medical instruction-tuning dataset in the open-source LLM community, especially for medical dialogue and instruction-following research.
notes: Dataset is machine-generated with expert-curated seeds and used for instruction tuning medical LLMs.
